notes.title: Update 1.05.1 - Minor Fix
notes.content:
[i][u][b]FIXED[/b][/u][/i]
-Dialogue Disabled by default for new players

Hey guys, thanks for tuning in! Jobi and I are hard at work on bringing the next chapter to Starlight Scouts! Thanks everyone for enjoying the game, hope you're doing great!

notes.title: Episode 1 - Eclipse [Coming Soon]
notes.content:
Jobi and I are hard at work on creating the next chapter of Starlight Scouts. We are actively working on Episode 1, as well as Multiplayer! We are working on getting a good timeline out, but Multiplayer comes with some uncertainties, and we don't want to promise a solid date just yet.

notes.title: Update 1.05 "Quick Controlled Bursts"
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=9iS5XQEmHig;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]ADDED[/b][/u]
-Full Controller Support
-Hatch Animations on Pause Screen
-New Splash Screen Animation

[u][b]FIXED[/b][/u]
-Switched to DX11 as DX12 was causing GPU crashes on the Start Screen
-Disable Dialogue Button now saves
-Buttons will no longer cause your ship to take collisions
-Fixed E0M7 Scout Badge Achievement not populating

[u][b]CHANGED[/b][/u]
-Improved Collision Mesh of Ship, making random bumps less likely
-Collisions no longer register if they occur less than 0.1 seconds from eachother
-Changed Dev Time on E0M5 from 80 to 90 seconds

notes.title: Hotfix 1.04.1 "Woopsie Daisy!"
notes.content:
[u][b]FIXED[/b][/u]
-Fixed Lights Out Achievement being unobtainable
-Fixed Invulnerability post win not triggering
-Fixed E0M6 Player Start

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.035 "PROJECT EDDIE"
notes.content:
[u][b]FIXED[/b][/u]
-Maxstric Stuck point on E0M6 fixed. Max now slightly pushes you away, preventing ships from becoming stuck under his fins.

[u][b]CHANGED[/b][/u]
-Quick Restart Key is now [R]
-Death Screen Message now shows R/back button to restart

notes.title: 1.03 Hotfix "GHOST BUSTER"
notes.content:
[u][b]ADDED[/b][/u]
-Option to disable dialogue entirely, giving players a cleaner experience. Not everyone wants to hear my lovely voice all the time...

[u][b]FIXED[/b][/u]
-[i]"Ghost Buster"[/i] Achievement no longer triggers on the player's first run of a level...
-E0M6 Door opening

[u][b]CHANGED[/b][/u]
-E0M7 Balancing Changes

notes.title: 1.02 Hotfix
notes.content:

Enjoy!!!
